models.name: boiler_mean_specific_heat
models.title: Fuel-oil boiler modelled with the mean specific heat of the flue gases (cpbar)
models.summary: Fuel-oil heating boiler represented as a combustor (adiabatic flame temperature from the mean specific heat of the combustion products, routine cpbar of the ULiege combustion library) followed by a gas-to-water eps-NTU exchanger and an envelope-loss term; computes the boiler efficiency.
models.tags: boiler;combustion;fuel oil;mean specific heat;flue gas;eps-NTU;adiabatic flame temperature;on/off control;exercise
models.authors: Sylvain Quoilin (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory, CoolSolve example); Jean Lebrun (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory, EES reference model); Stéphane Bertagnolio (ULiege Thermodynamics Laboratory, EES reference model)

models.name: scroll_compressor_semi_empirical
models.title: Semi-empirical hermetic scroll compressor in a refrigeration cycle
models.summary: Reference model of Winandy, Saavedra & Lebrun (2002) as implemented by V. Lemort: six-step compression path (supply drop, heating-up, isentropic compression to the adapted pressure, isochoric compression, exhaust cooling, exhaust drop) with internal leakage, fictitious-wall heat transfers and electromechanical losses; parameters identified on a Copeland ZR72KC-TFD catalogue, refrigerant cycle reduced to an evaporator and a condenser at imposed saturation temperatures. A simplified variant without leakage (converted from the EES original in bar/kJ units) is included.
models.tags: scroll compressor;semi-empirical;reference model;parameter identification;refrigeration;part load;internal leakage;built-in volume ratio
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); model of Winandy, Saavedra & Lebrun (2002)
models.related: CSL-0001 (refrigeration cycle with a simple compressor model): same component at a constant-efficiency level of detail

models.name: two_stage_steam_compressor_intercooling
models.title: Two-stage compression of superheated steam with intercooling at the optimal intermediate pressure
models.summary: Superheated steam (0.15 kg/s, 100 kPa to 625 kPa, 100 K superheat) is compressed by a two-stage isentropic compressor with intercooling back to the supply temperature, the intermediate pressure being set by the rule of equal stage pressure ratios (the work-minimising choice for ideal gases, Cengel & Boles). The model compares the powers of the single-stage isentropic, two-stage and isothermal (INTEGRAL of v dP) compressors and of a liquid pump, and computes the heats rejected in the intercooler and by the isothermal compression.
models.authors: N. Paulus; B. Dechesne; S. Quoilin (course MECA0002)

models.name: counterflow_hx_oil_water
models.title: Counterflow heat exchanger - oil cooled by water (effectiveness-NTU)
models.summary: Counterflow heat exchanger cooling an oil of constant specific heat with water, rated with the effectiveness-NTU method: capacity rates, NTU, counterflow effectiveness, outlet temperatures and transferred power.
models.authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); S. Quoilin (CoolSolve example)

models.name: condenser_three_zones
models.title: Air-cooled condenser, three-zone parametric model
models.summary: Semi-empirical three-zone model (desuperheating, condensation, subcooling) of an air-cooled R134a condenser with epsilon-NTU laws and flow-rate-fitted conductances; ships the combined crossflow/counterflow configuration plus purely counterflow and purely crossflow variants.
models.source_path: ~/Nextcloud/thermo_models/modeles/Condenser_3_zones/Condenser three zones parametric model model (combined crossflow-counterflow) - CC080108-1.EES

models.name: dhw_tank_dynamic
models.title: Domestic hot-water storage tank: dynamic temperature evolution
models.summary: Transient energy balance of a fully mixed 500 L domestic hot-water tank over a 5-hour scenario (10 kW heater for 1 h, cooldown, 2 h tap draw with 12 C make-up water, ambient losses), integrated with INTEGRAL and a 1-s step.
models.tags: domestic hot water;storage tank;thermal storage;dynamic;time integration;exercise
models.authors: N. Paulus (ULiège, repetition assistant, per the source inventory); B. Dechesne (ULiège, repetition assistant, per the source inventory)

models.name: refrigeration_cycle_simple_compressor
models.title: Refrigeration cycle with a simple compressor model
models.summary: Vapour-compression refrigeration cycle driven by a reciprocating compressor described by a clearance-volume volumetric efficiency and a linear loss model; compares R22, R134a and propane.

models.name: rankine_cycle_60mw
models.title: Rankine cycle of a 60 MW steam power plant
models.summary: Simple Rankine cycle of a 60 MW steam plant (70 bar, 500 °C, 0.2 bar condenser): steam flow rate, boiler power, cooling-water flow rate, cycle efficiency, back-work ratio; state points as arrays for the diagrams.

models.name: cpbar_combustion_products
models.title: cpbar: mean specific heat of CmHn combustion products (function library)
models.summary: Three EES routines of the ULiege combustion library (cpbar, gamma, mmprod) returning the mean specific heat, the specific-heat ratio and the molar mass of the combustion products of a CmHn fuel in simplified air, between two temperatures, for complete combustion, incomplete combustion (with unburned-CO losses) or pure air.
models.tags: combustion;mean specific heat;flue gas;fuel-air ratio;excess air;incomplete combustion;unburned CO losses;function library

models.name: methane_tank_evaporation
models.title: Evaporation of liquid methane in a tank
models.summary: Liquid methane at 500 kPa in a tank evaporates due to heat input (level drop of 30 mm per hour); the model computes the evaporated mass and the volumetric flow rate of the gas leaving a heater at 500 kPa and 275 K.
